each demo request. An instance is over when a submission is correct or when the attempt

many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

import numpy as np, json
def solve(A):
    A=np.array(A); H,W=A.shape
    hrs=[r for r in range(H) if len(set(A[r].tolist()))==1]
    # vertical dividers: columns where ALL non-divider-row cells are the same single value (divider color)
    lr=set(A[r][c] for r in hrs for c in range(W))
    dcol=list(lr)[0]
    vcs=[c for c in range(W) if all(A[r][c]==dcol for r in range(H) if r not in hrs)]
    lc=dcol
    brs=[]; prev=0
    for r in (hrs+[H]): 
        if r>prev: brs.append((prev,r)); prev=r+1
    bcs=[]; prev=0
    for c in (vcs+[W]):
        if c>prev: bcs.append((prev,c)); prev=c+1
    P=[(0,1),(0,2),(1,2),(2,0),(2,1),(2,2),(2,3),(3,1)]
    out=A.copy()
    for (r0,r1) in brs:
        row=A[r0,:]
        # skip divider rows themselves; find cell color from leftmost non-divider col
        cands=[int(row[c]) for c in range(W) if c not in vcs]
        col=[v for v in cands if v not in (0,dcol)]
        col=col[0] if len(col)==1 else None
        if col is None: continue
        for (c0,c1) in bcs:
            for (dr,dc) in P:
                rr,cc=r0+dr,c0+dc
                if rr<r1 and cc<c1:
                    # stamp staircase only where cell is 0 or object color; preserve divider/noise color cells
                    val=int(A[rr][cc])
                    if val==0 or val==col: out[rr][cc]=col
    return out.tolist()
for name in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2']:
    got=solve(G[name+' input']); exp=G[name+' output']
    print(name, got==exp)
    if got!=exp:
        d=[(i,j,int(got[i][j]),int(exp[i][j])) for i in range(len(got)) for j in range(len(got[0])) if got[i][j]!=exp[i][j]]
        print('n=',len(d),d[:10])

def f(gin):
    A=np.array(gin); H,W=A.shape
    dr=[i for i in range(H) if len(set(A[i]))==1]
    dc=[j for j in range(W) if len(set(A[:,j]))==1]
    R=bands(dr,H); C=bands(dc,W)
    divc=set(A[i][0] for i in dr)|set(A[0][j] for j in dc)
    out=np.full_like(A,0,int)
    P={(0,1),(0,2),(1,2),(2,0),(2,1),(2,2),(2,3),(3,1)}
    for r0,r1 in R:
        for c0,c1 in C:
            sub=A[r0:r1+1,c0:c1+1].flatten()
            cnt=Counter(sub.tolist())
            # object color: most common non-divider
            candidates=[(v,c) for v,c in cnt.items() if v not in divc and c>=4]
            if not candidates: continue
            oc=max(candidates,key=lambda t:t[1])[0]
            for i in range(r0,r1+1):
                for j in range(c0,c1+1):
                    out[i,j]=oc if (i-r0,j-c0) in P else 0
    return [[int(x) for x in row] for row in out.tolist()]
for k in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2']:
    gi=G[k+' input']; go=G[k+' output']
    o=f(gi)
    print(k,'match:',o==go)
    if o!=go:
        a=np.array(o); b=np.array(go)
        print('diff',np.argwhere(a!=b)[:12].tolist())

        if not pts: continue
